snapshots.disclaimer: Pokémon Showdown ladder data. Not official in-game statistics.
notes: usage = weighted share of teams (rating-weighted above the cutoff), not win rate.
Mega formes appear as separate entries (e.g. Charizard-Mega-Y).
teammates/moves are normalised by the species weighted count; small samples are noisy.
